# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1708
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1708
- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1708
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1708
- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.

# pr-1708: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list

## Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1708
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1708
- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:

# pr-1708: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list

## Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1708
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1708
- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.

# pr-1708: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list

## Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.

- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ### External-spec evidence rule A finding whose core claim is "**the spec / reference / ticket / external tool says or does X**" may be raised at 🚨 **BLOCKING** only when it quotes the exact source the review actually read during this run — a `file:line` reference or a doc URL. A bare "the spec says …" assertion is unfalsifiable for the author and for the machine, and a false one holds a validated PR hostage (live: a BLOCKING thread claiming an exemption list that the reference source did not contain — the reviewed code was behaviorally identical to it). Without a verifiable citation: - Downgrade the finding to ⚠️ **IMPORTANT**, phrased as a question: "Please confirm against `` — if confirmed, this becomes blocking." - Never let an uncited spec assertion be the sole reason for `REQUEST_CHANGES`. This is not a strictness cut: a spec-claim finding **with** a verifiable citation keeps full 🚨 BLOCKING force. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. - **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

This is not a strictness cut: a spec-claim finding **with** a verifiable citation keeps full 🚨 BLOCKING force. ## 7. - **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

Does not block merge. This is not a strictness cut: a spec-claim finding **with** a verifiable citation keeps full 🚨 BLOCKING force. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1708
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1708
- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).

- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.

## Test evidence (standalone SDK in the worktree; shared host dart is SIGKilled)

- `dart analyze` on all touched files: **No issues found**.
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_chatgpt_oauth_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_provider_identity_test.dart test/cli/agent_cli_model_test.dart test/cli/custom_providers_test.dart` → **68 passing, 0 failing**, including:
  - rewritten `a second codex auth re-auths the same identity (#1706: rename, never a twin entry)` — two OAuth rounds (`work` → `personal`) end with ONE entry named `personal`, blob in its name-scoped slot;
  - rewritten `a new name on a second auth renames the entry and re-picks its model (#1706)` — guided pick lands on the renamed single record;
  - unchanged `re-auth to the SAME entry keeps its model` (Enter path intact) and `a same-named entry on a different backend never receives the login` (domain-constrained alias resolution intact);
  - new `#1706: a custom-named codex record folds onto the chatgpt domain` (load merge) + `different-endpoint providers keep their own identities` (fold is codex-specific);
  - new `a saved chatgpt entry lists the codex /models answer (#1706)` — the picker refresh hits `{base}/models` and the codex row lists the live ids (plus the saved id, per the documented union) instead of the single seed.
- Adjacent suites green: `agent_cli_provider_test.dart` (118), `settings_flow_test.dart` (106), `copilot_provider_test.dart` + `llm_relay_sec_test.dart` (41), `roles_custom_providers_boot_test.dart` + `provider_key_lifecycle_test.dart` + `aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` (21), `provider_export_test.dart`, `add_provider_picker_test.dart`, `models_for_endpoint_test.dart`, `fresh_install_provider_flow_test.dart`.
- `dart format` applied to all touched Dart files.

AGENTS.md updated: the ChatGPT OAuth contract (one identity per auth domain, rename keeps the entry) and the model-list dispatch (codex `/models` + bundled synced catalog for the chatgpt-codex kind).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1708
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1708
- **Title**: fix(1706): codex auth single provider identity + full model list
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1706-codex-auth-provider-naming` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 7
- **Additions**: +342
- **Deletions**: -151
- **Created**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-19T10:39:52Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1706 (does not close — linking for traceability; close on the issue side when verified).

## Root causes (the three from the issue)

1. **Second codex auth minted a parallel entry.** The OAuth save path resolves the existing same-domain record first (base URL via `_entryForBaseUrl`, alias spelling via `_entryForCanonicalName`), but the provider-name step treated any typed name as a NEW account boundary: `registry.find(newName) == null` → `registry.add(...)` — a second entry. First add named `chatgpt.com` (the host-derived default), second add with a custom name → two `/provider` rows for one ChatGPT account.
2. **Custom name vs `chatgpt` identity.** Same mint path: a custom-named record became a parallel provider identity instead of a label on the one chatgpt domain record (the `/provider kimi routes-to-catalog` convention: one identity per built-in provider).
3. **Model list showed only the model picked at add time.** The `/model` picker's per-entry cache refresh (`_fetchIdsForProvider`) had NO chatgpt-codex branch — the dispatch fell through to `_fetchOpenAiShapeIds`, which answers `[]` for the codex dialect (`api: responses`, not `openai-completions`). The cache then held the single-id last-resort seed (`entry.modelId`): exactly one model.

## Fixes

1. `_applyChatGptOAuthCredentials` (lib/src/cli/provider_commands.dart): when a same-domain record exists, the login lands ON it. A typed name RENAMES the record (the edit wizard's rename shape: drop old record, save under the new name; creds go to the new name-scoped key slot), and the guided model pick re-runs. Enter keeps name + model (re-auth in place — unchanged). The account picker's "add another account" became "sign in again (re-auth)".
2. `CustomProviderRegistry` load merge (lib/src/cli/custom_providers.dart): for the chatgpt-codex backend the AUTH DOMAIN is the identity — a custom-named record and the derived `chatgpt.com` spelling fold onto one entry at config load (union keeps key slot/model, merge note printed). Other providers keep name-based identities (kimi/dial legitimately host several same-endpoint accounts). The owner's existing duplicate heals on next start.
3. `_fetchIdsForProvider` (lib/src/cli/provider_models.dart) gained the chatgpt-codex branch: the same call codex-rs' models-manager makes — `GET https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/models` under the account's OAuth blob (verified against openai/codex `codex-rs/model-provider/src/models_endpoint.rs` + `codex-api/src/endpoint/models.rs`: `{CHATGPT_CODEX_BASE_URL}/models`, `ModelsResponse{models:[{slug,…}]}`) — via the existing `_CodexDialect` (`fetchModelsForEndpoint`), whose bundled synced catalog (`chatGptCodexModels` from `scripts/sync_codex_models.dart` ← codex-rs models.json) answers whenever the endpoint can't, so the picker lists the full catalog (8 slugs today), never fewer than the live answer.
